title: Employees with department name
task: Set result to employees merged with departments on dept_id, keeping name, dept, salary.

title: Headcount per department name
task: Set result to a Series of employee counts per dept name, sorted descending.

title: Average salary per department
task: Set result to a Series of mean salary per dept name, rounded to 0 decimals.

title: Multiple aggregations
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by level with columns headcount (count) and avg_salary (mean salary, 0 dp), sorted by level.

title: Tenure in years
context: Date arithmetic to a fixed date.
task: Set result to employees with a column tenure_years = whole years from hire_date to 2025-07-31 (int).

title: Long-tenured staff
task: Set result to the names (Series) of active employees hired before 2019-01-01.

title: Attrition rate
task: Set result to the attrition rate = employees who Left / total, as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal.

title: Attrition per department
task: Set result to a Series of attrition rate (% Left, 1 dp) per dept name.
hint: groupby then apply mean of the boolean.

title: Gender pay gap by level
task: Set result to a DataFrame: index level, columns gender, values mean salary (0 dp), using pivot_table.

title: Manager names
task: Set result to a DataFrame with emp name and manager name (as manager) for employees that have a manager_id. Merge employees to itself.
hint: merge left on manager_id, right on emp_id.

title: Team sizes
task: Set result to a Series of number of direct reports per manager_id, sorted descending.

title: Salary band function
task: Set result to employees with a column band: 'High' if salary >= 2500000, 'Mid' if >= 1200000, else 'Low' (treat missing as 'Low').

title: Fill missing salary
task: Set result to employees with salary missing values filled by that employee's level median salary.

title: Average rating per employee
task: Set result to a Series of mean rating per emp_id (2 dp), for employees with reviews.

title: Top performers
task: Set result to a Series of emp_id with mean rating >= 4.5 (need at least one review).

title: Reviews with names
task: Set result to reviews merged with employees on emp_id, keeping name, year, rating.

title: Leave days per employee
task: Set result to a Series of total leave days per emp_id, sorted descending.

title: Leave by type
task: Set result to a Series of total days per leave type, sorted descending.

title: Employees with no leave
task: Set result to the names (Series) of employees with no rows in the leave table.

title: Never reviewed
task: Set result to the number of employees with no review rows (an int).

title: Exits per year
task: Set result to a Series of number of exits per calendar year (from exit_date), sorted by year.

title: Tenure at exit
task: Set result to a Series of tenure in days (exit_date − hire_date) for employees who left, indexed by emp_id.

title: Salary rank within level
task: Set result to employees with a column salary_rank = dense rank of salary (descending) within each level, as int (missing salaries get NaN → drop them first).

title: Highest paid per department
task: Set result to a DataFrame of the highest-paid employee per dept_id (columns dept_id, name, salary), sorted by dept_id.

title: Level by department
task: Set result to pd.crosstab of dept_id (rows) vs level (columns).

title: Age bracket
task: Set result to a Series of counts per age bracket using pd.cut with bins [20,30,40,50,60] and labels ['20s','30s','40s','50s'].
answer:
b = pd.cut(employees['age'], bins=[20, 30, 40, 50, 60], labels=['20s', '30s', '40s', '50s'])
result = b.value_counts().sort_index()

title: Last name initial
task: Set result to a Series of the first letter of each employee's last name (text after the first space), uppercase.

title: Promotion rate by year
task: Set result to a Series of promotion rate (% promoted, 1 dp) per review year, sorted by year.

title: Exit before hire
task: Set result to the number of employees whose exit_date is earlier than hire_date (an int; ignore blanks).

title: Future-dated exits
task: Set result to the number of employees with exit_date after 2025-07-31 (an int).

title: Remote share per department
task: Set result to a Series of the share of remote workers (% , 1 dp) per dept name.

title: Department budget per head
task: Set result to a Series of budget per employee (budget / headcount, 0 dp) per dept name.
hint: headcount per dept, join to budget.
answer:
hc = employees.groupby('dept_id').size().rename('hc')
d = departments.merge(hc, on='dept_id')
result = (d['budget'] / d['hc']).round().set_axis(d['dept'])

title: Most common hire month
task: Set result to the month number (1-12) in which the most employees were hired (an int).
